messages:
Sam (support): heads up — deploy-bot kicked off a canary for runtime v2.14 on eu-dedicated at 22:00 UTC. tagging eng-oncall in case we need a hold.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: workspace=eu-dedicated, units=8, group=canary-1, image=runtime:v2.14, sha=7a3b2f. streaming logs -> https://deploys.internal/redwood/1829991234

Alex K: seeing token latency spike in canary-1 at ~22:04 UTC, p50 -> 120ms -> 320ms, p95 -> 800ms. also higher KV cache miss rate. quick logs:
```
KVCache miss rate: 0.12 -> 0.56
request_id=eu-5498 latency=780ms model=redwood-rl-3
```

Priya S: thanks. canary looks unhealthy. recommend immediate hold + pin remaining eu pools to runtime v2.13 until we triage. not confident in rolling forward.

Elaine M: agree with hold. drafting status page + customer blurb below — please review and sign off.

Elaine M: STATUSPAGE DRAFT (short):
"We are pausing a scheduled runtime update for EU dedicated customers after increased latency was observed in a small canary group. Impact: brief latency increases for a subset of requests in canary hosts. Action: we have halted the rollout and reverted canary hosts to the previous runtime. We are investigating root cause and will provide an update within 2 hours. If you see persistent errors, please contact support@redwood.ai or open a ticket."

Elaine M: EMAIL SUBJECT: "Notice: brief pause to EU dedicated runtime update (Feb 27)"

Elaine M: EMAIL BODY SNIPPET (short):
"Hi — we paused a planned runtime update to your EU dedicated pool after detecting increased latency in a limited canary. We reverted canary hosts to the prior runtime and are investigating. There should be no persistent impact to your production traffic. We will send an update with our findings in ~2 hours. If you have concerns, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai. — Redwood Inference Ops"

Sam (support): recommend we send the statuspage short message now and the email to customers with reserved capacity > X and any who opted for advance notice. Ops, can you tag the impacted customer list?

Priya S: running rollback on canary-1 now and pinning remaining eu pools. script: `./ops/pin-runtime --region eu --version v2.13 --reason "canary latency"`

deploy-bot: Action: canary-1 rollback executed successfully at 22:08 UTC. new image=runtime:v2.13, all canary hosts reporting healthy.

Ops-bot: Impacted customers (reserved capacity) flagged: redwood-creatives, finance-lytics, scalepay-eu. Contacting them via Priority Notify channel as well.

Alex K: logs look back to baseline after revert. continuing to collect traces for the 22:00 window (KV cache op profiles + kernel timings).

Sam (support): ok sending statuspage short now and queuing the customer email list. Elaine — will use your snippets, minor edits: add support contact link and timeframe (we'll update within 2 hours).

Elaine M: ack. pushing to statuspage and starting email draft.

Sam (support): POSTED to statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/eu-runtime-update-brief-pause (short note live).

Priya S: follow-up plan: 1) collect kernel perf logs & compare to v2.13, 2) run a controlled canary with increased telemetry sampling, 3) if stable, resume rollout with staggered windows and tighter SLO gates.

Sam (support): I'll coordinate the customer emails and attach the incident link. will post a copy of the sent email here for records.

Alex K: quick ask — keep the change window notes for next roll: reduce concurrency for KV warm-up, and add an automatic rollback threshold at p95 > 600ms.

Elaine M: noted. adding to postmortem checklist and release notes.

Sam (support): closing thread for now, will update when the customer emails are sent or if triage finds an actionable root cause. :thumbsup:
